event.title: Indian Man Sentenced for Plot to Assassinate Sikh Separatist in New York
event.canonical_title: Indian Man Sentenced for Plot to Assassinate Sikh Separatist in New York
event.summary: Nikhil Gupta has been sentenced to over 19 years in prison for conspiring to hire a hitman to assassinate Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, a Sikh leader based in New York. Gupta admitted guilt in a federal court in New York regarding the plot targeting the dual U.S.-Canadian citizen.

timeline.title: Indian Man Sentenced for Plot to Assassinate Sikh Separatist in New York
timeline.summary: Nikhil Gupta has been sentenced to over 19 years in prison after pleading guilty to charges related to a conspiracy to assassinate a Sikh separatist leader in New York. Gupta admitted to collaborating with an Indian government official to hire a hitman for the murder, which authorities have linked to a broader effort to target Indian dissidents abroad.
key_facts: Nikhil Gupta sentenced to over 19 years in prison
Pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire and conspiracy charges
Plot involved hiring a hitman to kill a Sikh separatist leader in New York
Linked to efforts by Indian authorities to target dissidents
